# Arco

> Arco is a PHP CLI (`multiapi/arco`, installed with `composer require --dev`) that builds Laravel and plain PHP apps
> and deploys them to AWS Lambda Web Functions with FrankenPHP. The app is configured in `arco.php` at the project
> root; `vendor/bin/arco deploy --env=<env>` builds, uploads, deploys, verifies and rolls back on failure. It also
> manages a console function (`arco command`, `arco tinker`, migrations, the scheduler), SQS queues with worker
> functions, S3 storage, DynamoDB tables, custom domains (CloudFront) and VPC access.

Coding agents: start with `docs/agents.md`. It covers running Arco without a terminal (`-n`, `--yes`, `--json`, exit
codes), every command and `arco.php` method, common workflows and the error keys with their fixes. In a user's
project these files are under `vendor/multiapi/arco/`.

## Docs

- [Arco for coding agents](docs/agents.md): ground rules, non-interactive use, command and `arco.php` reference, workflows, error keys
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): install, `arco init`, AWS profiles, secrets, deploys, CI and `--json`, IAM permissions
- [Configuration reference](docs/configuration.md): every `arco.php` method with defaults, merge rules, queues, storage, tables, domains, VPC, runtime
- [Config layer](docs/config-layer.md): the JSON document merged over `arco.php` (`--config-layer`, `ARCO_CONFIG_LAYER`): keys, merge and conflicts, `adopt`, inventory additions
- [Try your app locally with Floci](docs/local-floci.md): deploy to a local AWS emulator with `AWS_ENDPOINT_URL`
- [Upgrading](docs/upgrading.md): breaking changes per version and what 1.x keeps stable
